A. Fixture Sum
time limit per test: 2 seconds
memory limit per test: 256 megabytes

This is a synthetic offline fixture, not a real Codeforces problem. Given integers $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$, compute $$$a+b$$$.

Constraints: $$$1 \le a,b \le 10^9$$$. Unicode: α ≤ β.

Input

Two integers $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$.

Output

Print the sum.

Input
2 3
Output
5
